title: Genesys Dice Forge
description: Dedicated native-WebGL 3D narrative dice module for Genesys. Zero-config automatic Genesys roll capture, rendered-chat fallback, integrated chat-toolbar launcher positioned beside Foundry chat utilities, three randomized physical roll profiles, guided in-motion deterministic face landing, deterministic 52-face visual QA cycler, hold-pose continuity, premium physical dice, authentic face composition, always-on-top presentation, standalone roll simulator, adaptive audio, Foundry VTT 13.351 and Version 14.
